method: 30 accounts per casual/regular/heavy style, 45 days. Actual time-based service, auto route, once-only capped star claims, quests, journal, draws, gear, presets and selector commands. Registered V5 root seeds with disjoint train/acceptance master blocks; the original public-command policy and style budgets are retained. No currencies, levels, unlocks, or rewards injected. Synthetic increasing clock; no wall-time claim. Missing milestones are censored at day 45.
